name: get_stats
description: Token-cheap document census for a session: words, paragraphs, tables, images, and a 500-words-per-page page estimate in a single small envelope. Counters are the exact engine counters behind CLI stats, so both surfaces always agree. Read-only: never mutates, never bumps the revision. Returns {ok:true,sessionId,revision,dirty,words,paragraphs,tables,images,pages}. Use instead of inspect_document when only counts are needed (a full TOON dump costs thousands of tokens for the same question). Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {"ok":true,"words":42,"paragraphs":5}. IDs are session-scoped: valid only in the issuing session, must not be stored across sessions. ECMA-376 essentials: colors are hex without # (e.g. 4F46E5, never #4F46E5); font sizes are half-points in w:sz (e.g. 28 = 14pt, 22 = 11pt); spacing/margins/cellMar use twips dxa (twentieths of a point, e.g. 240 = 12pt, 180 = 9pt); borders use eighths-of-a-point sz (e.g. 32 = 4pt left accent). Workflow: open_document -> inspect_document -> search_content -> execute_batch -> save_document -> close_document. Always inspect first, batch second, save third. Single edit = 1-item batch. Never call twice when once suffices.
